# GET /api/v1/licenses/{name}

Returns full information about a specific license template including body text

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** none · **ID:** `ep-014`

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| name | path | string | True |

## Response

**200** — LicenseTemplateInfo

| `name` | string | License display name |
